# User-Agent rules for crawler bots
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Prevent crawling of build metadata or system generated files
Disallow: /dist/
Disallow: /.firebase/
Disallow: /node_modules/

# XML Sitemap Location (Change the URL once you deploy to your custom domain)
